properties.site-address: Main Hall Park Prewett Northbrook Crescent Basingstoke
properties.notes: Planning permission was granted for a net gain of 19 units in March 2015 (13/02321/FUL) . The site is under construction and the developer (Taylor Wimpey) has confirmed, through the site monitoring consultation, that the remaining units will be delivered in 2017/18. A planning application has been submitted to provide an additional 9 units in the hall (17/00565/FUL), and this is awaiting determination.. Conversion of main hall to 19 residential units and 300m2 of community space
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
